decisions.reason: The client selects predefined rates for the package-pricing display instead of using the separately quoted calculator for that display. The independently defined instant quote calculator is already deferred, and this source does not modify or remove its retained behavior.
The source changes package pricing presentation, not the separate diagram and transparency requirements for individual service pricing.
Predefined square-footage rates remain compatible with one-time pricing and do not change the requirement to omit monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The package pricing model does not change the requirement for a navigation entry leading to detailed pricing information.
The gallery organization requirement is unrelated to the package square-footage pricing decision.
The package square-footage pricing decision does not affect gallery hover animations.
The source concerns package pricing categories and does not change the homepage image or overlay design.
The predefined package-pricing matrix does not alter the sitewide requirement for image-focused visual design.
The pricing decision does not change the requirement to associate each listed service with a relevant image.
The package square-footage pricing decision has no semantic effect on homepage gallery animation.
